outbound_field_diff.py:285-287 pass assignee_resolver/local_ticket_types/jira_key/local_id/conflict_sink — not OutboundMapper params, not a mapper call

Real call sites: outbound_field_diff.py:291 `outbound_mapper.map_fields_to_remote(changed, ticket=..., binding_store=..., local_ticket_types=...)`; :353 `map_fields_to_remote({...}, ticket=...)`; outbound_differ.py:548 `outbound_mapper.map_local_to_remote(ticket, binding_store=..., local_ticket_types=..., suppressed_out=suppressed_parents)`
findings.finding: The Cluster-2 keyword-call-site citation is misattributed and the true consumer file is unenumerated. The plan states OutboundMapper call sites 'pass by keyword (outbound_field_diff.py:285-287,346-348)', but those lines are not OutboundMapper method invocations: 285-287 pass jira_key=/local_id=/conflict_sink= to a different helper, and 346-348 is title/description diffing logic with no mapper call. The actual keyword call sites that make a Protocol rename unsafe are outbound_field_diff.py:291-292 (map_fields_to_remote called with ticket=/binding_store=/local_ticket_types=) and :353-354, plus outbound_differ.py:548-552 (map_local_to_remote called with binding_store=/local_ticket_types=/suppressed_out= by keyword). The last one passes suppressed_out= by keyword — the exact rename hazard the plan singles out — yet outbound_differ.py is never named as a consumer.
findings.location: CLUSTER-2 section; AC line 'Cluster-2 carries justified # noqa: ARG002 referencing the Protocol'

findings.checklist_item: Reconcile the '# noqa: ARG00x' remediation (Cluster-2 + bucket-4) with RUF100 (unused-noqa), which is enabled via `RUF` in select while `ARG` is not: since an ARG-noqa is itself an unused-noqa that fails default `ruff check`, replace the noqa mechanism with an alternative that passes both gates (e.g. leave rename-unsafe sites RAW as `--select ARG` residuals with a tracking note, or scope them differently) and update the AC accordingly.
evidence: pyproject.toml:358 `select = [... "RUF"]` enables RUF100 (unused-noqa) by default
pyproject.toml:366 comment: 'a NEW RUF finding fails CI everywhere'; pyproject.toml:367 only ignores RUF001/2/3
Plan text: 'Resolution: # noqa: ARG002 with a Protocol reference' and bucket-4 'resolve with # noqa: ARG00x + a one-line reason'
ARG is deliberately NOT added to select (AC: 'ARG is not added to select') — so ARG-suppressing noqas are unused-noqa under RUF100

The ticket's own execution comment independently confirms: 'KEY FINDING (RUF100 landmine): pyproject select includes RUF (RUF100 unused-noqa ON) but NOT ARG, so a # noqa: ARG00x is itself an unused-noqa -> default ruff check FAILS. Rename-unsafe params must stay RAW --select ARG residuals, never noqa'd.'
findings.finding: The plan's prescribed remediation of '# noqa: ARG00x' / '# noqa: ARG002' for Cluster-2 (7 sites) and all of bucket-4 will FAIL the default lint gate, because RUF is enabled in select (pyproject.toml:358) which activates RUF100 (unused-noqa) tree-wide, while ARG is NOT selected — so a '# noqa: ARG00x' suppressing an unselected rule is itself an unused-noqa that RUF100 flags. The plan never analyzes this RUF100/ARG interaction.
findings.location: Classification bucket 4; CLUSTER-2 'Resolution: # noqa: ARG002'; AC lines 'Every bucket-4 ... carries a # noqa: ARG00x' and 'Cluster-2 carries justified # noqa: ARG002'
scenarios: Executor applies '# noqa: ARG002' to the 7 Cluster-2 Protocol sites, then runs default `ruff check src/rebar` (the actual CI gate) and it fails with 7 RUF100 unused-noqa errors
Any bucket-4 site marked with '# noqa: ARG00x' fails the RUF100 gate the same way
findings.suggested_fix: State the remediation as: rename-unsafe (bucket-4) and Cluster-2 Protocol sites stay RAW (no `# noqa`), documented as deliberately-retained `--select ARG` residuals, because a `# noqa: ARG00x` under the active RUF100/unselected-ARG combination is itself a RUF100 unused-noqa that fails the default `ruff check`. Update the AC lines that mandate `# noqa: ARG00x`/`# noqa: ARG002` accordingly, and record the reason in the per-site note instead of a noqa comment.
